verses.text: “Here’s the rule for the guilt offering: it’s most holy. 🕊️
“Slaughter the guilt offering where the burnt offering is slaughtered, then splash its blood all around the altar. 🩸
“Offer all its fat: the fat tail and the fat covering the inner parts; 🐏
“both kidneys with the fat near the loins, and the liver’s covering, removed with the kidneys. 🐏
“The priest will burn these on the altar as a fire offering to Yahweh. This is the guilt offering. 🔥
“Every male among the priests may eat it in a holy place. It’s most holy. 🙏
“The sin offering and guilt offering follow the same rule. The priest who makes atonement with them gets the offering. ⚖️
“When a priest offers someone’s burnt offering, he gets the animal’s hide for himself. 🐑
“Every grain offering baked in an oven, pan, or griddle belongs to the priest who offers it. 🍞
“Every grain offering—mixed with oil or dry—belongs equally to all of Aaron’s sons. 🌾
“Here’s the rule for peace offerings brought to Yahweh: 🕊️
“If you bring one as a thank-you, bring unleavened oil-mixed cakes, unleavened wafers brushed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil alongside the thanksgiving offering. 🍞
“Bring leavened bread too, along with your thanksgiving peace offering. 🍞
“Lift one portion from each offering to Yahweh as a contribution. It belongs to the priest who splashes the peace offering’s blood. 🙌
“Eat the meat from your thanksgiving peace offering on the day you bring it. Don’t leave any until morning. 🍽️
“If your offering is for a vow or given freely, eat it on the day you bring it; whatever’s left can be eaten the next day. 🍽️
“But burn any meat still left on the third day. 🔥
“If anyone eats the peace-offering meat on the third day, the offering won’t be accepted or credited to the one who brought it. It’s offensive, and whoever eats it must answer for their guilt. ⚠️
“Don’t eat meat that has touched anything unclean; burn it instead. Anyone who is clean may eat the other meat. 🔥
“Anyone who is unclean but eats meat from Yahweh’s peace offering must be cut off from their people. ⚠️
“Anyone who touches human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any unclean creature, then eats meat from Yahweh’s peace offering, must be cut off from their people.” ⚠️
Yahweh spoke to Moses: 📜
“Tell Israel: Don’t eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats. 🚫
“You may use the fat of an animal that died on its own or was torn apart for other purposes, but don’t eat it. 🚫
“Anyone who eats fat from an animal offered to Yahweh as a fire offering must be cut off from their people. ⚠️
“Don’t eat blood from any bird or animal, wherever you live. 🚫
“Anyone who eats any blood must be cut off from their people.” ⚠️
Yahweh spoke to Moses again: 📜
“Tell Israel: When someone brings Yahweh a peace offering, bring part of that offering as Yahweh’s gift. 🤲
“Bring the fire offerings with your own hands. Bring the fat and the breast so the breast can be lifted before Yahweh as a presentation offering. 🙌
“The priest will burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons. 🔥
“Give the priest the right thigh from your peace offerings as a contribution. 🦵
“The son of Aaron who offers the peace-offering blood and fat gets the right thigh as his share. 🍖
“I’ve taken the presentation breast and contribution thigh from Israel’s peace offerings and given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their lasting share from Israel.” 📜
This is Aaron’s and his sons’ assigned portion from Yahweh’s fire offerings, from the day they were presented to serve Yahweh as priests. 🙏
Yahweh commanded Israel to give them this share on the day they were anointed. It belongs to them through every generation. 📜
That’s the rule for the burnt, grain, sin, and guilt offerings, the ordination offering, and the peace offering—📋
everything Yahweh commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, when he told Israel to bring offerings to Yahweh in the Sinai wilderness. ⛰️
